spans.s: मय् vt. 1Ā (pres. मयते) To go, to move.
मय (I) a. (f. यी) Used as an affix in the sense of ‘consisting of, made of, full of,’ e.g. सुवर्णमय, तेजोमय, जलमय.
मय (II) m. 1. Name of a demon, the architect of the Daityas; 2. a horse; 3. a camel; 4. a mule.
माय m. 1. A juggler; 2. a demon, an evil spirit.

माया f. 1. Trick, illusion, artifice, deceit; 2. an illusory image, a phantasm, a phantom, मायां मयोद्भाव्य परीक्षितोऽसि R.ii.62, Bt.xvii.107; 3. political artifice, diplomacy; 4. wickedness; 5. the Pradhāna of the Sāṅkhyas (q.v.); 6. illusion which makes one see the supreme spirit and the universe to be two distinct realities (in Vedānta phil.); 7. pity, compassion.; 8. name of the mother of Buddha.
मय (I) a. (f. यी) Used as an affix in the sense of ‘consisting of, made of, full of,’ e.g. सुवर्णमय, तेजोमय, जलमय.
मयट m. A hut of grass.
मय(यु)ष्टक m. A kind of bean.
मय(यु)ष्टक m. A kind of bean.
मयु m. 1. A Kinnara, a celestial musician; 2. a deer, an antelope.
मायु m.n. Bile, the bilious humour.
मयु-राज m. an epithet of Kubera.
मयूख m. 1. A ray of light, lustre, brightness, विसृजति हिमगर्भैरग्निमिंदुर्मयूखैः Sak.iii., Rt.i.13, Kir.v.8, R.ii.46; 2. a flame; 3. beauty.
मयूर m. 1. A peacock, फणी मयूरस्य तले निषीदति Rt.i.13, R.iii.56; 2. a species of flower; 3. name of a poet, the author of the Sūryaśataka, Pr.R.i.
मायूर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Belonging to a peacock; 2. drawn by peacocks; 3. dear to peacocks.
मायूर (II) n. A flock of peacocks.
मयूर-अरि m. a lizard.
मयूर-केतु m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
मयूर-ग्रीवक n. blue vitriol.
मयूर-चटक m. the domestic cock.
मयूर-चूडा f. a peacocks crest.
मयूर-तुत्थ n. blue vitriol.
मयूर-पत्रिन् m. an arrow feathered with peacock’s feathers.
मयूर-रथ m. an epithet of Kārtikeya.
मयूर-व्यंसक m. a cunning peacock.
मयूर-शिखा f. a peacock’s crest.
मयूरक (I) m. A peacock.
मयूरक (II) m.n. Blue vitriol.
मायूरक m. A peacock-catcher.
माया-आत्मक a. illusory.
माया-कार, -कृत्, -जीविन् m. a juggler.
माया-कार, -कृत्, -जीविन् m. a juggler.
माया-कार, -कृत्, -जीविन् m. a juggler.
माया-द m. a crocodile.
माया-देवी f. name of the mother of Buddha.
माया-देवी˚सुत m. an epithet of Buddha.
माया-पटु a. fraudulent, delusive.
माया-प्रयोग m. 1. application of tricks; 2. employment of magic.
माया-मृग m. an illusory antelope.
माया-योग m. employment of magic.
माया-वचन n. a deceptive speech.
माया-वत् (I) a. 1. deceptive, illusory; 2. skilled in magic.
माया-वत् (II) m. an epithet of Kansa.
माया-वाद m. a term applied to Buddhism.
माया-विन् (I) a. 1. employing deceit, using diplomatic tricks, भवंति मायाविषु ये न मायिनः Kir.i.30, 2. skilled in magic.
माया-विन् (II) m. 1. a cat; 2. a magician; 3. a demon.
माया-विन् (III) n. a gallnut.
माया-सुत m. an epithet of Buddha.
मायिक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Deceitful, trickish; 2. illusory.
मायिक (II) m. A juggler.
मायिक (III) n. A gallnut.
मायिक (I) a. (f. का) 1. Deceitful, trickish; 2. illusory.
मायिन् a. the same as मायाविन् q.v., Kir.i.30.
मायूर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Belonging to a peacock; 2. drawn by peacocks; 3. dear to peacocks.
मायूरक m. A peacock-catcher.
